# toml++

The unmodified single-header toml++ 3.4.0 parser is reused from the reference
Dice! source tree. It replaces the incomplete line-oriented legacy reply parser
without adding a vcpkg dependency or changing the existing CI dependency cache.

Upstream: https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus/tree/v3.4.0

License: MIT; the full copyright and license notice is retained in `toml.hpp`.
